title: Russia targets Danube port after one of Ukraine’s largest aerial attacks of the war
summary_full: Russia struck port infrastructure in Ukraine’s Odesa region, damaging a Togo-flagged civilian vessel near Izmail after Kyiv launched a major drone attack on Moscow.
